summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is an ASP.NET web page that provides administrative staff with a view to filter and manage student employment applications. It contains interactive controls for filtering applications by site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status, and displays results in a grid. The page integrates validation, dropdown population, paging, and workflow logic to ensure reliable filtering and presentation of submitted and withdrawn applications.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with a flexible interface for viewing, filtering, and managing student employment applications by site, discipline, timeframe, and application status within the HSPnet system.

fields.name: cmdRefreshView
fields.description: Button to refresh the application view

workflows.name: Filter Employment Applications
steps: Staff selects site, discipline, start date, end date, and withdrawn status from filters.
Staff clicks Refresh View or changes filter values.
System validates date fields (required, regex, custom logic: StartDate <= EndDate).
System binds and displays filtered employment applications in the grid.
Paging and empty data handling are managed within the grid.

business_rules: Start date and end date are required fields.
Start date must be less than or equal to end date.
Withdrawn applications are shown based on checkbox selection.
Empty disciplinary or site selection inserts 'All' option.
Grid shows up to 50 results per page with paging controls.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator for txtStartDate and txtEndDate (date format).
calculations: DateFormatter.FormatDateShort for default values and display formatting.
DateFormatter.ParseDate for converting input text to date objects.
conditions: If SiteID query parameter is present, pre-select site in dropdown.
If staff changes filter dropdowns (site/discipline), grid refreshes automatically.
system_behavior: Initial page load sets dropdown filters, date fields, and refreshes grid.
Default date range is last 3 months to today.
Grid supports paging, empty results messaging, and row data binding for application details.
Displays last login info and timezone for staff.
dependencies: Uses UserSession data for agency and filtering context.
Dropdowns depend on Site and Discipline data sources.
AJAX Toolkit CalendarExtender for date fields.
JavaScript functions for client-side validation and calendar controls.
exceptions: If date fields are missing or invalid, validation errors are shown.
If StartDate is after EndDate, custom validation fails.
If no data is returned for filters, empty data template displays.
content_gaps: No explicit UI screenshots or full HTML layouts.
Underlying database schema and business logic (especially for EmploymentApplication entity) not fully specified.
No coverage of the JavaScript file contents beyond validation function.
Some resources look-up values (labels, messages) are abstracted.
